svg.title: Source configuration for n=25
svg.desc: Three views: equal-radius disks clipped to the unit disk, the source center triangulation, and each center's boundary coverage arc. Approximate illustration; not a proof or a uniqueness claim.
svg.text: Source-derived candidate. Center IDs match configurations.json. Edges connect triangle vertices; they do not denote disk tangency.
Arcs use double-precision circle intersections and slightly offset tracks for readability. Illustration does not certify arc closure or global optimality.
